# Success

The main delivery risks relate to software stability, integration, and testing, and will be mitigated through progressive development, automated testing, QA, and systematic verification.

## Definition of done

The funded phase will be considered complete when a technically strengthened, stable, tested, and reproducible MVP of Transparent Statistical Learning with R/Shiny is available. This version will include strengthened existing functionality, organized and reusable code, automated testing, statistical verification of relevant results, improved interface and visualizations, and a reproducible software environment.

## Measuring success

Success will be measured based on the proper functioning of the main workflows, completion of the planned improvements, results of automated testing, and verification of selected statistical results. This will include functional and automated testing using reference datasets and scenarios, independent calculations, and verification of the reproducibility of the environment and analyses.

## Future work

Subsequent phases may address comprehensive statistical and functional validation, expanded technical and user documentation, publication, translation, deployment, and further consolidation of the platform. The platform may also be progressively expanded through new statistical procedures, diagnostics, visualizations, documentation resources, and contributions from the R community.
